# Redfern Plastering Solutions

> Brisbane-based plastering business specialising in high-quality plaster repairs, patching, renovations, and small to medium-sized residential and commercial projects. ABN 61 947 738 353. Phone 0425 743 992.

Redfern Plastering Solutions provides professional workmanship and friendly service from start to finish. Every job is completed to a high standard, on time and with minimal disruption.

## Services

- [Plaster repairs & patching](https://redfern-plastering.vercel.app/services/plaster-repairs): holes, cracks, cut-outs, nail pops, rental changeovers. Cracks are taped, not just filled.
- [Ceiling repairs](https://redfern-plastering.vercel.app/services/ceiling-repairs): access cut-outs, sagging sheets, water stains, cornice, truss-uplift cracks.
- [Renovation plastering](https://redfern-plastering.vercel.app/services/renovation-plastering): full-room re-sheets, strip-outs, Level 4 and Level 5 finishes, square-set or cornice.
- [Water damage plaster repairs](https://redfern-plastering.vercel.app/services/water-damage-plaster-repairs): re-lining after storms and leaks, moisture-checked before re-boarding, insurance scopes.
- [New plasterboard installation](https://redfern-plastering.vercel.app/services/plasterboard-installation): extensions, garage conversions, room splits, wet-area board.
- [Commercial plastering](https://redfern-plastering.vercel.app/services/commercial-plastering): repairs, make-goods and fit-out linings, scheduled around operating hours.

## Pricing

Indicative 2026 Brisbane prices: wall patches $100–$300, ceiling cut-outs $250–$600, ceiling sheet replacement $300–$550, water-damage re-lines $450–$1,000, full-room re-sheets $1,600–$2,800. Full breakdown: [Brisbane plastering cost guide](https://redfern-plastering.vercel.app/plastering-costs-brisbane). Every job gets a firm written quote before work starts.

## Answers to common questions

- **How much does a plaster repair cost in Brisbane?** Most small repairs run $100–$550; see the cost guide for per-job ranges. Text photos for a firm written price.
- **Do you take on small jobs?** Yes — single patches and repairs are core work, not an inconvenience.
- **Why do cracks keep coming back?** Movement: truss uplift or frame settling. Repaired without tape, cracks reopen. Redfern tapes every crack so the repair flexes with the house.
- **Can you match a textured ceiling?** Smooth finishes disappear completely. Heavier stipple or orbital textures can usually be blended, but a perfect match on decades-old texture isn't always possible — stated honestly before starting.
- **Repair or replace a ceiling sheet?** Localised damage patches cleanly; a delaminated or sagging sheet is cheaper to replace than to fight.
- **Is pre-1990 fibro or hardboard a risk?** Yes — pre-1990 ceilings get asbestos-tested before any cutting. Redfern flags this on sight.
